purpose: Test whether the previous standing-variation > de-novo-mutation hierarchy persists when mutation input is scaled relative to initial additive genetic variance and when genetic variance is followed through time.

Houle_Morikawa_Lynch_1996.use: morphological traits had mean VG/VM on the order of 100 generations; use VM/VG0 = 0.01 per generation as the central empirically anchored sensitivity, not as a species-specific calibration

Mackay_et_al_meta_analysis_2022.use: published mutational heritability estimates span roughly 2.5e-5 to 1.02e-2 and plant estimates tend lower; this motivates broad sensitivity rather than a single natural value

calibration_boundary: Model 3 contains no environmental variance VE, so literal mutational heritability VM/VE cannot be calibrated. Mutation input is instead normalized to the model's initial allelic additive-variance proxy.

mutation_input.sigma_solution: for diploid trait mean z=(a1+a2)/2 and rare independent mutation, VM ~= mu*sigma_m^2/2; solve sigma_m=sqrt(2*r*VG0/mu) separately for each founder population

primary_endpoints: investment allelic additive-variance proxy through time
variance_definition: VA_proxy = variance of all investment allele values / 2; exact for an additive diploid trait under independent allele sampling and used here as a transparent within-model proxy rather than an empirical quantitative-genetic estimate

predeclared_decisions.standing_dominates_at_400_if: mean absolute response(high standing, r=0) > mean absolute response(low standing, r=0.01), averaged over visitor histories and capacities
predeclared_decisions.ranking_reversal_if: low-standing r=0.01 exceeds high-standing r=0 at the corresponding horizon
predeclared_decisions.near_plateau_if: for each low-standing mutation-input cell, absolute change in mean VA_proxy from year 600 to 800 divided by mean VA_proxy over years 600 and 800 is < 0.1
predeclared_decisions.headline_rule: retain 'standing variation dominates over the tested finite horizon' only if standing_dominates_at_400 is true; if central-anchor ranking reverses, remove that claim. Year-800 and plateau results define the time-horizon limitation.

claim_boundary: This is an empirically anchored sensitivity, not calibration to a named species or floral trait.
VG/VM literature values arise from natural quantitative-genetic systems and do not make the Model 3 trait scale empirical.
The VA proxy is a within-model additive-variance diagnostic and does not include environmental variance.
Reflection at [0,1], selection and finite demography make realized mutation input depart from the rare-mutation approximation; actual variance trajectories are therefore reported.
All mutation-input ratios, both capacities and both visitor environments must be reported regardless of result.
